keyEvents.text: Goal! Sassuolo 0, Genoa 1. Milutin Osmajic (Genoa) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Hamed Traoré with a through ball.
Goal! Sassuolo 0, Genoa 2. Milutin Osmajic (Genoa) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom right corner following a fast break.
Substitution, Sassuolo. Kieron Bowie replaces Sebastiano Esposito.
Substitution, Sassuolo. Ibrahim Sulemana replaces Fali Candé.
Kristian Thorstvedt (Sassuolo) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Genoa. Vítinha replaces Tommaso Baldanzi.
Substitution, Genoa. Morten Frendrup replaces Alex Amorim.
Substitution, Genoa. Ethan Meichtry replaces Junior Messias.
Substitution, Sassuolo. Benja Domínguez replaces Nemanja Matic.
Substitution, Sassuolo. Simone Cinquegrano replaces Ignace Van der Brempt.
Substitution, Genoa. Lorenzo Colombo replaces Milutin Osmajic.
Substitution, Genoa. Samuel Wiafe replaces Hamed Traoré.
Substitution, Sassuolo. Josh Doig replaces Rafa Obrador.
Delay in match because of an injury Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
